description: TY2025: the SAME ISO exercise a year earlier — the pre-OBBBA 25%/$626,350 phase-out leaves the FULL $88,100 exemption intact: base 461,900 -> TMT 124,550 -> AMT $72,527.00 (vs $79,578 in 2026: the OBBBA's $500k/50% reset RAISES AMT despite the bigger exemption).
